claim: Export tables v6 through v12 adapt ABI signatures into common operations; modern profiling handles and baseline device-interface output arguments remain ignored where shown.
v11/v12 context stores traffic class and netRefCount reconciles repeated initialization; context/refcount publication precedes common init result without automatic rollback.
Modern finalize frees passed context and finalizes common plugin when reference count leaves its last live reference.
Properties advertise host-driven networking, conditional GPU/DMA-BUF support, explicit v12 fields, and null irecvConsumed hooks.
Common init rejects an already initialized plugin, initializes parameters, translates construction failures, and fini deletes/nulls global plugin.
Common listen/connect accept resource_key but actual endpoint lookup uses domain_key plus calling thread ID; corrected ABI chapter scope.
Incomplete connect retains communicator endpoint through handle state and shared ownership; scope exit drops temporary references.
Device/domain caches are weak while communicators retain endpoints and endpoints retain domains; cache presence is not tensor ownership.
Explicit protocol provenance takes requested initializer; default chooses multi-rail RDMA otherwise SENDRECV and discards single-rail RDMA despite broader comment.
Selected plugin complete_init precedes temporary endpoint probe and final properties/GDR-dependent checks.
Provider capability helper records virtual addressing, endpoint-MR scope, auto/manual progress and enforces pinned EFA runtime minimum.
Endpoint invalidate sets ep_active false and removes endpoint from domain cache; it does not invalidate the entire domain.
Parameter initialization is a separate early phase before transport construction.
check_sources verifies DEFAULT/API/ENVIRONMENT and check_late_set rejects changing a consumed parameter.
AWS provider default applies when FI_PROVIDER is absent or exactly efa; protocol default requires matching provenance/platform conditions.
Endpoint config rejects null endpoint, short-circuits non-EFA and checks selected GDR/native-write/ordering prerequisites.
Platform manager registers build-gated candidates and selects priority/manual policy rather than discovering model workload intent.
NIC grouping clamps group count, distributes quotient/remainder sizes, and applies platform rail sorting before splitting.
Synthetic same-switch, host-bridge-only, unequal-depth, disjoint, and missing-node checks match the bounded topology explanation.
check_gdaki_flags validates opted-in and opted-out platform policy cases without executing device networking.
Provider discovery filters selected provider/fabric and applies configured TCP interface/address constraints.
SENDRECV registration uses a wrapper handle even when underlying provider descriptor is absent; null wrapper is not a universal permitted path.
Ordinary iovec registration key rounds covering granules except Neuron branch; DMA-BUF key carries sharing attributes.
MR cache uses covered page interval and required endpoint scope, increments hit references, and removes only final handle reference.
SENDRECV serializes cache lookup/provider registration/insertion and balances insertion failure with deregistration.
DMA-BUF viability checks build declarations, disable policy, device attributes, kernel import support, then supported path requires provider/API/HMEM conditions.
MR helper tests cover coverage, duplicate insertion, references and missing removal; endpoint-MR tests remain explicitly TODO.
Bitmap allocation returns FI_KEY_NOTAVAIL on exhaustion; invalid/duplicate frees throw.
Accepted tagged post increments inflight; EAGAIN progresses CQ, exposes null request, and frees slot without decrementing an unincremented count.
Payload matching uses negotiated communicator tag, receive supports one buffer and callback tag forwarding remains TODO.
CQ handlers recover request from op_context, record actual receive length, and terminal testing returns pooled storage under its branch.
Flush can skip, use GPU flush, or post fabric read and needs its own asynchronous progress/completion.
Incomplete connect saves communicator in handle, progresses connector, and rejects already-connected local handle state.
ReuseListenCommTest copies original peer handle for each connect attempt and exercises ten iterations plus four-thread variant.
Control mailbox readiness validates first sequence before trusting num_recvs, applies acquire fences, then checks remaining entries and unused matching tag.
RDMA receive publishes destination offset/capacity/tag/index/keys; send retains schedule and cursor and advances segment cursor only after accepted posts.
Internal EAGAIN pending path retains the request; repeat EAGAIN requeues at front and ends progress pass.
Ordinary remote-write completion aggregates request/subreceive/segment identity; remote-write errors avoid unreliable immediate-data identity and return EIO.
Early completion is gated by optional receive sentinel, automatic provider progress and disabled eager mode, with incompatible explicit config rejected.
RDMA successful test frees request, while shown error-state branch returns error without identical successful retirement.
CQ polling distinguishes empty CQ, EAVAIL/error record and deferred readerr EAGAIN; one tested request can progress others.
Strict small-message threshold has independent rotation; four-rail 8193-byte example yields two stripes of 4224 and 3969 bytes with aligned first boundary.
test_threshold_scheduler uses four rails, 4096 minimum stripe and 64 small threshold and checks actual rail/offset/length mapping.
test_tag_matching respects num_recvs bound and test_ready_bit checks masked sequence readiness/wrap conditions.
Named late-eager, grouped-mixed, tag-pushback and per-tag-order scenarios exist under their functional capability setup.
Grouped receive scenarios gate maxRecvs and use distinct payload patterns and completed-size checks.
poll_and_validate flushes CUDA receives on rank 1 but final byte comparison is rank-1 non-CUDA only; corrected broad fixture claims in three chapters.
Optional tuner can successfully return null context/fallback and prefers supported region unless model selection applies; missing callbacks preserve NCCL decisions.
test_p6_polygon_8_16_node_extension checks selected inside-range decisions and unchanged outside-range policy.
Gin initialization requires initialized OFI RDMA path, non-endpoint MR and supported GDRCopy forced-PCIe capability.
Direct context validates capability/backend layout, constructs guarded resources, and reports unsupported strong/VA signals in shown interfaces.
Symbol probe verifies proxy/direct exports against build gate without a fabric transfer.
Version refusal probe rejects null/negative/zero/above-max configuration before touching dummy communicator, not a supported GPU data test.
RDMA close marks inactive and queues deferred cleanup; last open send/receive close blocks, receive abort distinguishes pending flush completions.
InflightCloseTest deregisters and closes interrupted work and reconnects; it does not establish successful payload delivery.
Shared-library smoke test calls dlopen/dlclose for configured build and does not certify provider connectivity or payload correctness.
